sources.snippet: Overview vjepa2-vitg-fpc64-256 is a frontier video understanding model developed by facebook at FAIR (Meta). It extends the pretraining objectives of the original V-JEPA, achieving state-of-the-art video understanding capabilities by leveraging data and model sizes at scale. The model uses a Vision Transformer architecture (ViT-G variant) and processes videos with 64 frames per clip (FPC) at ...
